notes.title: PARKSIDE Demo patch 1.41
notes.content: [p]Hi all, this is just a very minor tweak to hopefully fix the bug people have been having where input stops working, and also I've changed 'leaning' to toggle rather than press-and-hold. That's about it for this update.[/p][p][/p][p]-BananaH[/p]

notes.title: PARKSIDE DEMO PATCH 1.4
notes.content: [p]Hey folks. This patch is a bit more delayed than I wanted due to some computer issues but thankfully I'm back up and running again.[/p][p][/p][p]This patch addresses a number of small bugs and also attempts to fix the bug where the player suddenly can't attack or interact with things at random.[/p][p]If this bug persists for you, please report it in the discussion board![/p][p][/p][p]Patch notes:[/p][p]- Updated player control in attempt to fix interaction freezing at higher framerates[/p][p]- Fixed jumpy fast scrolling in Advancements menu[/p][p]- Mission 1: Fixed geometry hole in water area, restarting and keeping XP and abilities bug, and Jonas Reeves infinite XP bug (I hope)[/p][p]- Nightmare: Graphics options in pause menu work again.[/p][p]- Mission 2: Fixed no collision on building near Discreet Club Sweet, and broken lightmap on nearby wall.[/p][p]- Main Menu: Fixed bug where you can't click on anything after finishing the demo.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, have fun and thanks for playing.[/p][p]-BananaH[/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed jumpy fast scrolling in Advancements menu
- Mission 1: Fixed geometry hole in water area, restarting and keeping XP and abilities bug, and Jonas Reeves infinite XP bug (I hope)
- Nightmare: Graphics options in pause menu work again.
- Mission 2: Fixed no collision on building near Discreet Club Sweet, and broken lightmap on nearby wall.
- Main Menu: Fixed bug where you can't click on anything after finishing the demo.

notes.title: NEW PARKSIDE DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content: [h3]IT'S TIME![/h3][p]Finally, I'm really excited to announce that the new PARKSIDE: DECAYED SOUL MANIPULATION demo is live! Among many other things, it features:[/p][p][/p][p]-New weapons to find and use[/p][p]-A totally new inventory system, grid with drag-and-drop[/p][p]-Character limb damage, status effects menu[/p][p]-Intel menu with mission maps/details[/p][p]-All character abilities and upgrades implemented and usable[/p][p]-A new tutorial mission, also accessible via the introduction cutscene[/p][p]-QOL: separate mouse invert axes and sensitivity, fixed control rebind errors, pausing in cutscenes, and much more![/p][p]-New NPCs and animations[/p][p]-New enemy types: including leeches and helicopters[/p][p]-Swimming![/p][p]-Driving cars![/p][p][/p][p]AND MUCH MORE![/p][p][/p][p]Get stuck in, and most importantly: enjoy! If you find any bugs or problems, feel free to report them on the Community Discussion Board![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for the continued support and have fun[/p][p][/p][p]-BananaH[/p]

notes.title: DEMO PATCH 1.2
notes.content:
Hi guys, this patch contains one or two essential changes and some more small bugfixes. It's intended to be the "final" version of the demo for a while. There are still imperfections but here is the list of changes:

-Added rebindable controls, which can be changed in the options menu (removed "Controls" option from the main menu) and in the pause menu (under "Controls")
-Instead of using Ctrl + A/D, the lean mechanic now uses two separate keys (Ctrl and Alt by default to lean left and right)
-Fixed a graphical bug with some electrical discharges
-Fixed a bug where Twist Grayson's store would explode immediately without a source of ignition when the gas is turned on
-Fixed a way to escape from the first mission and fall into the void
-Fixed an inventory/conversation screen conflict bug
-New ragdoll electrocution effect

There will not likely be any further patches to the demo until much closer to the game's final release. Be sure to follow me on X/Twitter at @BHardsoftGames if you want to stay in the loop. Please enjoy, and thank you for your support.

[b]-EDIT: Lockpicks now no longer need to be equipped to be used on doors, etc.[/b]


-BananaH

notes.title: DEMO PATCH 1.1
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who's played the demo so far. This patch includes a short, yet important list of improvements:

-Fixed an infinite XP glitch in the first mission.
-Added separate "Invert Mouse X" and "Invert Mouse Y" options.
-Added an option to view the controls to the in-game pause menu.
-Fixed the main menu UI cutting off in 21:9 aspect ratio
-Fixed a scrambled dialogue bug (90% sure on this one!)
-Fixed a bug where refusing to kill Jonas or talking to him too much would taint future dialogue despite restarting the mission.

If you haven't played the demo yet, I hope you enjoy it. I'm excited for what the future of PARKSIDE will bring.

-BananaH
